title: kit manifest
description: What kit init set up in a project, at <repo>/.claude/kit/manifest.json. Written only by plugins/kit/scripts/kit_manifest.py, after the owner approves kit init's proposal (repo ADR-0013). Read by foundry init, worktrees and the stop gate kit renders; no reader edits it (repo ADR-0012). A reader that finds a version it doesn't know treats the file as absent.

version.description: The manifest's shape. Goes up when a field is added, renamed or retyped.

kit.description: The kit version whose script wrote the file, such as 0.2.0.

checks.description: The project's own checks that kit found and the owner approved, in the order kit init proposed them.

gate.description: The kit gate that runs it: edit (after each edit), stop (before an agent stops) or none.

agents.description: Agent types the project uses, each with whether it is read-only. Sorted by name. A qualified name (plugin:name) is declared by that plugin; a bare name is a project agent under .claude/agents/.

name.description: The full agent type, matched exactly (case-insensitively) by readers: foundry:judge, never the bare judge.

readOnly.description: True when the type never edits files: it gets no worktree and the stop gate skips it. kit_manifest.py refuses readOnly: true for the types on this line (repo ADR-0013 amendment): Refused read-only types: general-purpose, kit:builder, kit:test-writer, foundry:architect, foundry:devops, foundry:lead, foundry:writer. The schema does not enforce that list, so a stored manifest that holds one still validates.

declaredBy.description: Who declared it: the plugin named by the type's prefix, or project for a bare name. kit_manifest.py refuses any other pairing (DECLARER_MISMATCH).

riskyPaths.description: Paths where a wrong edit is costly (migrations, deploy config, generated code), with the reason kit init gave.

setupScripts.description: The worktree setup scripts the project has, repo-relative. Non-empty means worktrees gives each worktree a PORT_BASE slot (repo ADR-0005).
